name: INTERFACE
purpose: Expose action vectors derived from resolved system evidence.
role: Invocation layer between resolution and future handoff.
question: What can the visitor actually do with what the system has resolved?
relationship_to_signals: Signals resolves capability; INTERFACE invokes that capability as action.
relationship_to_handoff: Handoff remains a future boundary and is not executed in Stage 9.

core_vectors.name: EXPLORE
core_vectors.visitor_sees: deeper internal surfaces, sublayers, or resolved structures that continue the Signals line of inquiry
core_vectors.system_prepares: a deeper inspection state and a clearer internal path

core_vectors.name: TRACE
core_vectors.action: follow the evidence and provenance behind a resolved capability
core_vectors.visitor_sees: causal links, source anchors, and structural references spanning Systems, Telemetry, Chronology, and local evidence
core_vectors.system_prepares: a provenance path that explains why the capability exists
core_vectors.unresolved_until_handoff: external transfer and any destination outside KalaOS

core_vectors.name: CONVERSE
core_vectors.action: enter a communication boundary and prepare human exchange
core_vectors.visitor_sees: a communication state that indicates readiness to open a channel, not a contact request
core_vectors.system_prepares: orientation toward communication, including the boundary that Stage 10 may later transfer through
core_vectors.unresolved_until_handoff: the actual external transfer, contact endpoint, or outbound message

readiness_criteria: Action vectors remain distinct from portfolio categories.
Signals remains the source of resolution.
